units.energy: No consumed event/stat/split field provides Wh, W, capacity or an energy integral. drain_pct is SOC percentage-point loss/proxy, not measured Wh. No conversion from SOC to kWh is implemented. Producer calibration and physical energy interpretation remain unknown.
units.time: Primary event duration_hours and stats total_observed_hours arrive in hours according to their consumed types. The observed metric multiplies hours by 3600 before the duration formatter; split duration_s remains seconds in cache and is divided by 3600 only for display. G02 records the noncanonical producer contract without remigration.
units.temperature: ambient_temp_c_avg is explicitly nullable Celsius; useUnits.formatTemperature passes it to unitConversion.formatTemperature:402-412, which preserves missing values and converts Celsius via convertTempFromSI:194-204. Fahrenheit uses absolute C*9/5+32, not a dose/delta conversion.
units.rates: drain_pct_per_day, avg/median/p95 are server-returned percentage points per day. The frontend does not reconstruct the rate by dividing a dose or average differently. KPI labels/description and gauge label carry per-day meaning; the generic metric unit is '%'.
units.dose: Daily display sums the returned loss and duration of whole windows; it neither integrates a power signal nor weights temperature exposure. Missing temperature does not imply zero degrees.
units.physicalSign: Finite signed split drain passes through drain() unchanged; tables and rollup do not apply abs/clamp. Gauge receives raw avg and preserveReadingAndScale. A negative SOC change is not proven recovered energy, and threshold text 'Lower is better' is not a producer-validation rule.
units.unknownVersusZero: Stats use null-safe raw metrics; split explicitly distinguishes null from numerical 0. Park booleans have a semantic confirmation defect (VD03). fmtNumber itself uses safeNumber's zero fallback, but required nonnullable event fields do not establish a legitimate null case; no corrupt-payload finding is asserted.
units.preferences: useNumberFormatting subscribes to locale/precision; useUnits consumes temperature preference. Percent labels are not distance units. Fixed h display is explicit in page metrics/table and split; duration preference behavior was not broadened. Dates omit explicit vehicle timezone/selected locale as in VD02.
units.wireClaimLimit: The consumed TypeScript shapes and route registrations were read; backend JSON producers, database storage, clipping, rate estimators and endpoint coverage semantics were not validated.

findings.rule: MDC-044/045; calendar attribution and exposure honesty
findings.detail: buildDailyDrainRollup assigns every event's entire drain_pct and duration_hours to localDayKey(started_at). ended_at is not used. The daily chart's battery-loss/parked-hours labels can therefore attribute a multi-day exposure entirely to its start date.
findings.mechanism: Whole-window dose and hours are summed into one start-day bucket, even though timezone grouping itself is vehicle-aware.
findings.repro: UNEXECUTED source-derived case: a valid UTC-zone window starts 2026-10-01T23:00:00Z, ends 2026-10-02T03:00:00Z, duration_hours=4 and drain_pct=1. The implementation puts all 4 hours and all 1 percentage point on October 1. No payload was injected or producer behavior assumed.
findings.fix: Either relabel as sessions grouped by start date, or use producer-backed daily interval/dose evidence. Do not invent a uniform time distribution of SOC loss. Hours can be intersected with calendar days separately if the source contract supports that.
findings.owner: page/domain worker; accurate daily-dose producer support requires separately claimed integration ownership

findings.rule: MDC-044; consistent timezone and localization preferences
findings.detail: Daily buckets use the selected vehicle timezone, but session starts, split starts/ends and trend axis/data labels call formatDateTime/formatDate without tz or locale. Those helpers use browser timezone/locale when options are absent. Timezone identity is not shown beside the readings.
findings.mechanism: One page presents vehicle-calendar aggregation alongside browser-calendar dates. Formatting can disagree with user locale/timezone preferences without a scope explanation.
findings.repro: UNEXECUTED: selected vehicle zone America/Los_Angeles, browser UTC, timestamp 2026-10-02T02:00:00Z. The rollup key is October 1 while the trend/table date is October 2. Changing the saved locale does not supply an explicit locale argument at these date call sites.
findings.fix: Use the existing preference-aware date boundary consistently and surface the interpreted zone. Pass existing tz/locale options through page and mobile/split accessors; preserve chosen hour-cycle semantics rather than creating a new formatter.
findings.owner: page and page-private presentation owners; shared formatting bridge only if existing API cannot expose required preferences

findings.rule: MDC-026; unknown/not-counted is not measured Off or confirmed live evidence
findings.detail: Any ParkTruth object makes all three booleans 'live' evidence. The active value uses *_counted, not *_reported or confirmed_park. The panel then renders inactive rows as Off with context 'Confirmed Park evidence'.
findings.mechanism: Payload presence establishes parkKnown; even the sentry_reported conditional returns 'live' on both sides. A not-counted device outside confirmed Park is rendered as Off instead of not counted/unconfirmed. Retained state is warned globally, but per-row derivation still labels evidence live.
findings.repro: UNEXECUTED valid contract case: confirmed_park=false, sentry_reported=true, sentry_counted=false. The source derivation gives active=false and evidence='live'; the consumer renders Off/Confirmed Park evidence. No corrupted or null boolean is required.
findings.fix: Separate reported state, Park eligibility and attribution evidence; show not-counted/unconfirmed rather than Off where confirmation is absent. Carry source trust into row presentation without rewriting retained bytes or making unowned producer changes.
findings.owner: battery domain utility and culprit presentation worker; producer contract changes, if needed, belong to integration

findings.detail: The unplugged action states that drain remains after Sentry/HVAC and is 12V upkeep or a genuine leak. The domain utility only takes a finite historical unplugged aggregate, compares it with zero, and chooses the first active row; it neither subtracts these causes nor aligns current Park evidence with the windows.
findings.mechanism: The narrative's residual/causal claim exceeds the consumed fields. Positive historical SOC loss is treated as a culprit without measured energy, temporal exclusion or attribution evidence.
findings.repro: UNEXECUTED: current counted flags are false and a valid historical unplugged aggregate is positive. deriveVampireCulprits chooses unplugged_leak and the stronger residual/leak explanation is displayed regardless of historical HVAC/Sentry exposure. Producer causes are unknown, not presumed.
findings.fix: Label this as observed unplugged SOC loss with unconfirmed cause; distinguish independent current Park truth from historical correlation. Only use a residual/cause claim if separately owned producer evidence actually supports it.
findings.owner: culprit presentation/domain worker; causal evidence producer remains unowned integration work

findings.rule: Complete page actions and source-independent freshness
findings.detail: The action named Refresh vampire drain refetches only stats/events. Park/split evidence and the successful historical split are outside both the callback and parent source/freshness descriptors.
findings.mechanism: A healthy split has no SourceRecovery retry control, and its historical hook does not poll. Page refresh can update the rate summary while leaving split/culprit historical inputs untouched.
findings.repro: UNEXECUTED: all four deterministic sources are successful; invoke the page callback. Exactly the statsQuery and eventsQuery refetch handles are called; neither physics hook is invalidated. No HTTP request was made.
findings.fix: Either label the action's narrower scope explicitly or connect the existing physics cache identities to the page refresh, preserving independent error/retry and avoiding duplicate split requests.
findings.owner: page with claimed hook/integration coordination if needed; no shared/global changes authorized here

findings.detail: Refresh remains rendered with no disabled or enabled guard when no vehicle is selected, despite query enabled=false. Its callback manually invokes both refetch handles and its query functions interpolate an empty activeId.
findings.mechanism: Manual refetch does not use the consumer's enabled check to prevent callback invocation. Empty scope is forwarded into the request URL construction.
findings.repro: UNEXECUTED source-derived: vehicleId=null makes activeId=''; activating Refresh invokes both refetch functions whose URLs contain vehicle_id=. Backend rejection/fleet fallback is unknown and is not claimed.
findings.fix: Disable or guard Refresh until valid vehicle scope exists, preserving its localized accessible name and 44px target. Add source-local pending/busy semantics in the appropriate corrective item, not here.

findings.detail: deriveVampireCulprits appends a fixed English explanatory sentence to report.honesty. The consumer renders that string directly as brief description and caption, even if producer honesty is empty and the selected UI locale is non-English.
findings.mechanism: The fixed frontend-owned sentence has no t() boundary. Producer honesty strings are separate unowned data-contract questions, not automatically catalog omissions.
findings.repro: UNEXECUTED: choose any non-English UI locale with a valid source object or unresolved sources. The appended English sentence is still present in report.honesty and rendered twice.
findings.fix: Move the deterministic sentence to the localized presentation boundary or return a structured explanatory identity from the utility. Use the existing catalog integration owner for required keys; do not recase or translate arbitrary producer text as identifiers.
findings.owner: battery domain/presentation worker plus separately claimed catalog integration if a new key is required

findings.rule: MDC-002; typed hooks own reads, pages orchestrate
findings.detail: Stats/events are still defined with useQuery and request in the page. The consumed physics sources instead use domain hooks and queryPolicy. This is a source architecture gap, not a demonstrated failed request.
findings.mechanism: Page-local URL construction, payload interfaces and caching behavior bypass the existing domain hook ownership boundary. Correct paths, vehicle keys and cancellation are nevertheless preserved.
findings.repro: UNEXECUTED source inspection: page owns both queryFn definitions and has no queryPolicy spread; hook consumers use useTeslaPhysics with tier policy. Ambient retry/client policy was not changed or inferred.
findings.fix: Assign a bounded hook-integration item for the existing endpoints, preserving keys, enablement, signal and actual response shapes; migrate the consumer only after that ownership is established.
findings.owner: API-hook integration and page owner; explicitly not this QA worker

findings.rule: MDC-026; distinguish first-load paused/deferred from loading or failure
findings.detail: For paused queries without retained data, SourceRecovery enters its warning branch but StaleRefreshWarning returns null when !hasData. The only recovery body can be Retry, beside a skeleton or missing evidence. Physics sources are not registered in parent dataSources, so there is no inspected parent notice compensating for those panels.
findings.mechanism: deriveDataState preserves status='initial' and isRefreshBlocked=true without data, while the retained-warning component intentionally supports only retained data.
findings.repro: UNEXECUTED legitimate query state: no payload/error, fetchStatus='paused', with refetch available. Park/split panel recovery shows a retry but no visible reason that the initial load is deferred. This does not prove the vehicle or browser is offline.
findings.fix: Add a feature-local no-retained paused/deferred explanation through the existing feedback contract; keep retained warnings and independent retry behavior unchanged. If a shared primitive lacks that state, request its existing owner's extension rather than altering it from this item.
findings.owner: page-private SourceRecovery owner; separately claimed shared feedback extension only if necessary
